evidence: The rear filter face houses a segmented LED display with three battery icons and 'Med' text matching the non-catalogue Dyson V11 Animal.
contradictions: The V12 Detect Slim and V15 Detect both feature full-colour particle-counting LCDs, while the remaining catalogue models lack this handheld filter display.
